about: Pass 8 research (2026-10-09/10), topic: refresh existing licensed LLM sources to their latest snapshots. Candidate rows only; data/ was not edited. For each ledger source the newest upstream commit/revision was checked; only epoch-internal (benchmark_data.zip, re-fetched 2026-10-09, sha256 a2381ce3…) changed content in an internal file (frontiermath_erdos.csv +2 rows). Every other source (BFCL-Result, EQ-Bench 3, Aider, LiveCodeBench site, Galileo, ZeroEval, EvalPlus, Arena-Hard-Auto, WildBench, Vector Inspect, BrowserGym, WebApp1K, Roblox, Judgemark v2, SciCode, ARC Prize datasets, MathArena outputs, Terminal-Bench, tau2-bench, Vectara, AlpacaEval) is still at its pinned commit/revision, so the rows here are (a) catalogue models present in the pinned files but never recorded (mostly because earlier imports took only target models or the catalogue entry was added later) and (b) rows for 11 proposed catalogue models that land in existing multi-model runs. No value changed in any refreshed source, so nothing is re-added. Merge: ledger entries first (add_match entries extend existing entries' match lists; strip action/note), then models (strip nothing; all keys are existing catalogue keys), then results via npm run import. One new benchmark (math-l5-zeroeval). Row 'by' is 'lab' only for the Qwen τ²-bench submissions and the OpenThinker2 card's own rows.
